entries.Original: . Acknowledge it in the main window before retrying.
entries.Translated: 。请在主窗口中确认后再重试。

entries.Original: Please configure your preferred shop territory in the Settings tab!
entries.Translated: 请在设置标签页中配置你偏好的商店区域！

entries.Original: Still scanning vendor data — try again in a few seconds.
entries.Translated: 仍在扫描商人数据 — 请稍等几秒后重试。

entries.Original: Still scanning Firmament data — try again in a few seconds.
entries.Translated: 仍在扫描天穹街数据 — 请稍等几秒后重试。

entries.Original: Cannot start automation while in combat.
entries.Translated: 战斗中无法启动自动化。

entries.Original: Cannot start automation while in a duty.
entries.Translated: 任务中无法启动自动化。

entries.Original: Inventory near full — pausing Artisan to turn collectables in.
entries.Translated: 背包接近满 — 暂停 Artisan 以提交收藏品。
提交完成 — 恢复 Artisan 列表。

entries.Original: Resource inspection done — starting Artisan list.
entries.Translated: 资源检查完成 — 开始 Artisan 列表。
购买列表完成！正在停止自动化。

entries.Original:
Opens the main UI. 
/collector config - Opens up the config UI
/collector collect - Starts turning in collectables.
/collector inspect - Runs the Skybuilders' resource inspection.
/collector changelog - Opens the changelog.
entries.Translated:
打开主界面。
/collector config - 打开配置界面
/collector collect - 开始提交收藏品。
/collector inspect - 运行天穹街资源检查。
/collector changelog - 打开更新日志。

entries.Original: Custom commands — run any chat command at points in the loop (before the Artisan craft starts, after a turn-in, buy or Kupo run, when the loop goes idle, ...), e.g. /li gc to craft away from the vendor. Optionally wait until travel is done before continuing (Settings → Integrations)
entries.Translated: 自定义命令 — 在循环的各个节点运行任意聊天命令（Artisan 制作开始前、提交/购买/库啵好运道之后、循环空闲时……），例如 /li gc 可在远离商人处制作。可选择等待移动完成后再继续（设置 → 集成）

entries.Original: Fixed Kupo of Fortune crashing the game
entries.Translated: 修复库啵好运道导致游戏崩溃的问题

entries.Original: Fixed Firmament turn-ins stalling on the second item
entries.Translated: 修复天穹街提交在第二件物品时卡住的问题
修复资源检查无限循环的问题

entries.Original: Added /collector kupo to play your held Kupo of Fortune cards on demand
entries.Translated: 新增 /collector kupo 命令，可按需使用持有的库啵好运道卡片

entries.Original: Resource-inspection options now only appear on Firmament (where they apply), and the Normal system regains its 'Craft selected Artisan list on autogather finish' option
entries.Translated: 资源检查选项现在只在天穹街（适用场景）显示，普通系统恢复“自动采集完成后制作所选工匠列表”选项

entries.Original: Fixed the scrip shop run wandering off when you weren't in your preferred shop's zone — it now stops cleanly instead of walking toward out-of-zone coordinates
entries.Translated: 修复了不在首选商店区域时，刷票据商店会乱跑的问题——现在会干净地停止，而不是朝区域外坐标移动

entries.Original: The Kupo of Fortune and resource-inspection features live under the still-experimental Firmament mode (System toggle → Shift-click 'Firmament'). Please report anything that breaks
entries.Translated: 库啵好运道和资源检查功能位于仍处于实验阶段的天穹街模式（系统开关 → Shift 点击“天穹街”）。如有异常请反馈

entries.Original: Kupo of Fortune automation — after a Firmament turn-in, automatically walk to Lizbeth and play your held cards so Kupo Vouchers earned past the 10-card cap aren't wasted. Configurable play threshold and chest choice (Settings → General)
entries.Translated: 库啵好运道自动化——天穹街交付后，自动走向莉兹贝丝并使用持有的卡片，避免超过 10 张上限后获得的库啵兑换券被浪费。可配置使用阈值和宝箱选择（设置 → 通用）

entries.Original: Skybuilders' resource inspection and a full hands-free loop — chain GatherBuddyReborn autogather → resource inspection → Artisan craft → collect, then restart (Settings → Integrations)
entries.Translated: 天穹街资源检查与全自动循环——串联 GatherBuddyReborn 自动采集 → 资源检查 → 工匠制作 → 收藏品采集，然后重新开始（设置 → 集成）

entries.Original: Artisan crafting now triggers correctly inside the Firmament — it was silently inert before
entries.Translated: 工匠制作现在能在天穹街内正确触发——此前会静默失效

entries.Original: Added an in-progress status while an Artisan list is crafting
entries.Translated: 新增工匠列表制作进行中的状态显示

entries.Original: Fixed a Kupo of Fortune game crash, and Kupo interactions now respect your configured UI delay
entries.Translated: 修复了库啵好运道游戏崩溃的问题，库啵交互现在会遵循你配置的 UI 延迟

entries.Original: Added a 'stop after N full loops' stop condition, with full-loop counting in the session stats (Planner and Settings → Goal)
entries.Translated: 新增“完成 N 次完整循环后停止”的停止条件，会话统计中会记录完整循环次数（规划器与设置 → 目标）

entries.Original: Fixed Firmament appraiser row resolution so the correct collectable is turned in
entries.Translated: 修复了天穹街鉴定师行解答所问题，确保交付正确的收藏品

entries.Original: Per-addon UI delays — tune the wait for each game window individually (Settings → Timing)
entries.Translated: 按插件区分的 UI 延迟——可单独调整每个游戏窗口的等待时间（设置 → 计时）

entries.Original: Auto turn-in when you open a Collectables shop or Firmament appraiser window yourself — skips travel and doesn't start buying (Settings → General)
entries.Translated: 当你自行打开收藏品商店或天穹街鉴定师窗口时自动交付——跳过移动且不会开始购买（设置 → 通用）

entries.Original: Kupo now waits for a real appraiser run before playing, resets the voucher count afterwards, resumes an interrupted turn-in, and skips the voucher pause on manual window turn-ins
entries.Translated: 库啵现在会等待真正的鉴定师流程后再使用，之后重置兑换券计数，恢复被中断的交付，并在手动窗口交付时跳过兑换券暂停

entries.Original: The changelog now credits outside contributors inline, and you can reopen it any time with /collector changelog or Settings → General → View changelog
entries.Translated: 更新日志现在会内联标注外部贡献者，并可随时通过 /collector changelog 或 设置 → 通用 → 查看更新日志 重新打开

entries.Original: Experimental Firmament (Skybuilders' Scrip) support — turn in Skybuilders' collectables and buy from the Firmament scrip shop.
entries.Translated: 实验性天穹街（天穹工匠票据）支持 — 可交纳天穹工匠收藏品，并在天穹街票据商店购买。

entries.Original: Firmament mode is experimental — in the System toggle, hold Shift and click 'Firmament' to enable it. Expect rough edges, and please report anything that breaks
entries.Translated: 天穹街模式为实验性功能 — 在系统开关中按住 Shift 并点击“天穹街”即可启用。可能存在粗糙之处，如有问题请反馈

entries.Original: Added a 'Copy troubleshooting info' button (Settings → General and on the hard-fail banner) — paste it along with your issue report
entries.Translated: 新增“复制故障排查信息”按钮（设置 → 常规以及硬失败横幅上）— 请将其与问题报告一并粘贴

entries.Original: Purchases and turn-ins are now verified against your actual scrip count, so a missed dialog can no longer record progress that didn't happen
entries.Translated: 购买和交纳现在会与实际票据数量核对，因此漏掉的对话框不会再记录未发生的进度

entries.Original: Fixed the Deliveroo run crashing right after teleporting (now waits for the navmesh to be ready) and disabling Deliveroo mid-list
entries.Translated: 修复了 Deliveroo 在传送后立即崩溃的问题（现在会等待导航网格就绪）以及列表中途中禁用 Deliveroo 的问题

entries.Original: Fixed the stop button fighting the Artisan inventory-full watcher — stopping now sticks
entries.Translated: 修复了停止按钮与 Artisan 背包已满守望者冲突的问题 — 现在停止会生效

entries.Original: Fixed the Artisan inventory-full pause giving up silently and timing out while the last craft finished
entries.Translated: 修复了 Artisan 背包已满暂停时静默放弃、以及在最后一次制作完成时超时的问题

entries.Original: Inventory space is now only checked when actually buying, not when starting automation
entries.Translated: 现在仅在真正购买时检查背包空间，而非启动自动化时

entries.Original: Summoning bells in inns and player housing are recognized again for AutoRetainer
entries.Translated: 旅馆和玩家房屋中的召唤铃再次可被 AutoRetainer 识别

entries.Original: Vendor data now loads in the background instead of stalling the game on login
entries.Translated: 商人数据现在在后台加载，不再在登录时卡住游戏

entries.Original: Planner tab is much lighter on the framerate
entries.Translated: 规划器标签页对帧率的影响大幅降低

entries.Original: Multi-character scrip balance dashboard (Characters tab) — refreshes on login and after each turn-in / buy cycle, so AutoRetainer cycles piggyback samples for every character
entries.Translated: 多角色票据余额仪表盘（角色标签页）— 在登录时及每次交纳/购买循环后刷新，因此 AutoRetainer 循环会为每个角色顺带采样

entries.Original: Discord webhook notifications on hard-fail, goal complete, stop-condition, and (optional) scrip-cap reached
entries.Translated: 硬失败、目标完成、停止条件以及（可选的）票据上限达到时的 Discord webhook 通知

entries.Original: User-configurable stop conditions: scrips earned, buy cycles, session minutes
entries.Translated: 用户可配置的停止条件：获得票据数、购买循环数、会话分钟数

entries.Original: Planner now credits collectables already in your bags against the estimated turn-ins (overview and per-row table)
entries.Translated: 规划器现在会将背包中已有的收藏品计入预估交纳数（总览和逐行表格）

entries.Original: Planner Session panel shows per-currency scrips earned alongside scrips spent
entries.Translated: 规划器会话面板显示各货币获得的票据以及花费的票据

entries.Original: Settings → Goal grows a Stop Conditions section with enable+value rows
entries.Translated: 设置 → 目标新增停止条件区域，包含启用+数值行

entries.Original: Refreshed the changelog UI to match the rest of the theme; dropped the OtterGui dependency
entries.Translated: 更新了更新日志界面以匹配整体主题；移除了 OtterGui 依赖

entries.Original: Refreshed the UI styling across the main, planner, and settings tabs
entries.Translated: 刷新了主界面、规划器和设置标签页的界面样式

entries.Original: Split the purchase list into separate Gathering and Crafting tabs
entries.Translated: 将购买列表拆分为采集和制作两个独立标签页

entries.Original: Added a hard-fail banner that halts automation when something goes wrong
entries.Translated: 新增硬性失败横幅，出错时停止自动化

entries.Original: Added a reserve scrip floor so purchases leave a configurable amount unspent
entries.Translated: 新增票据保留下限，购买时保留可配置的未花费数量

entries.Original: Added Deliveroo integration — can now check for Deliveroo between runs
entries.Translated: 新增 Deliveroo 集成 — 现在可在运行间检查 Deliveroo

entries.Original: Added a Planner tab for setting scrip goals and stopping automation when complete
entries.Translated: 新增规划器标签页，可设置票据目标并在完成后停止自动化

entries.Original: Merged settings into the main window — config window now just opens main window
entries.Translated: 将设置合并到主窗口 — 配置窗口现在仅打开主窗口

entries.Original: Reorganized the UI into tabs (Main, Planner, Settings)
entries.Translated: 将界面重组为标签页（主界面、规划器、设置）

entries.Original: Added collapsible panels and session stats tracking
entries.Translated: 新增可折叠面板和会话统计追踪

entries.Original: General code cleanup and bug fixes
entries.Translated: 常规代码清理和错误修复

entries.Original: Added the option to check for completed ventures between runs via AutoRetainer
entries.Translated: 新增选项：通过 AutoRetainer 在每次运行之间检查已完成的探险任务

entries.Original: Updated logic for reading scrip amount, fixing various issues
entries.Translated: 更新解析票据数量的逻辑，修复多项问题

entries.Original: Bandaid fix for cases where the user has missing scripshop subpages and it cant find the item - now forces through every sub page trying to find the item
entries.Translated: 临时修复用户缺少票据商店子页面导致找不到物品的情况——现在会强制遍历每个子页面以查找物品

entries.Original: Now matches scripshopitems with ItemIds instead of strings, supporting more languages than english (You might have to re-add your items to purchase for them to show up properly)
entries.Translated: 现在使用物品 ID 而非字符串匹配票据商店物品，支持英语以外的更多语言（你可能需要重新添加要购买的物品才能正常显示）

entries.Original: The plugin will now turn in any remaining collectables after finishing scrip shop purchases
entries.Translated: 插件现在会在完成票据商店购买后上交所有剩余的收藏品

entries.Original: Collectable turn-in will now abort early if you're hitting scrip cap again as well
entries.Translated: 如果再次达到票据上限，收藏品上交现在也会提前中止

entries.Original: Merged ArtisanBuddy functionality into TheCollector, adding the ability to craft a selected artisan list after autogather disables
entries.Translated: 将 ArtisanBuddy 功能合并到 TheCollector，新增在自动采集禁用后制作所选工匠列表的功能

entries.Original: Removed the feature to enable auto collectable turn-in after autogather disables
entries.Translated: 移除自动采集禁用后启用自动收藏品上交的功能

entries.Original:
With the most recent testing build of GatherBuddyReborn, it has implemented the feature to automatically turn-in collectables and also handle scripshop purchases.
For the time being I'm going disable the functionality of this Plugin till the next version, where I will cut out all the gatherable collectable stuff so it'll be crafting only.
This should be out in the next couple of days, a big thank you to anyone using the plugin and those who decided to support!♡
entries.Translated:
随着 GatherBuddyReborn 最新测试版构建，它已实现自动上交收藏品以及处理票据商店购买的功能。
目前我将暂时禁用本插件的相关功能，直到下个版本，届时我会移除所有可采集收藏品相关内容，使其仅保留制作功能。
这应该会在接下来几天内发布，非常感谢所有使用本插件的用户以及决定支持的人！♡

entries.Original: If you had your shop preferred shop set to Gridania, please select something else and then re-select Gridania for everything to work correctly, thank you!
entries.Translated: 如果你将首选商店设置为格里达尼亚，请先选择其他商店，然后重新选择格里达尼亚，以确保一切正常工作，谢谢！

entries.Original: Now properly checks if you can actually teleport when artisan is done crafting a list
entries.Translated: 现在会正确检查工匠完成列表制作后你是否真的可以传送

entries.Original: Fixed a bug where it wouldn't teleport when you're in a housing ward
entries.Translated: 修复了在住宅区时不会传送的问题

entries.Original: Now moves to the shop instead of teleporting if you're in the same territory and are somewhat nearby
entries.Translated: 现在如果在同一区域且距离较近，会改为走向商店而不是传送

entries.Original: Added failsafe for buying scrip items so it wont buy the wrong shop item anymore if it cant find the selected one in the shop tab
entries.Translated: 为购买票据物品添加了保护机制，当在商店标签页中找不到所选物品时，不会再购买错误的商店物品

entries.Original: Made it fetch the data for the scrip shop items from the git repo instead of locally, allowing for edits without having to actually update the plugin
entries.Translated: 改为从 git 仓库获取票据商店物品数据而非本地数据，这样无需实际更新插件即可进行编辑

entries.Original: Added Mason's Abrasive and fixed a few items indices
entries.Translated: 添加了 Mason's Abrasive 并修正了几个物品索引

entries.Original:
If your crafter or gatherer is high enough level but you haven't unlocked the corresponding Scrip Exchange tab (e.g. "Purple Scrip Exchange – Lv. 80 Materials/Bait/Tokens"), the plugin may purchase the wrong item.
Unlock the relevant Splendors vendor tabs before setting higher-level items.
entries.Translated:
如果你的制作或采集职业等级足够高，但尚未解锁对应的票据兑换标签页（例如“紫色票据兑换 – 80级 材料/鱼饵/代币”），插件可能会购买错误的物品。
在设置更高等级物品前，请先解锁相关的华丽品商人标签页。

entries.Original: Fixed collectable sorting in your inventory completely now
entries.Translated: 彻底修复了背包中收藏品的排序问题

entries.Original: Filtered 'Gazelle Leather' out of the list of collectables in your inventory since Luminas IsCollectable flag returns true for it for some reason???
entries.Translated: 从背包收藏品列表中过滤掉了“瞪羚皮革”，因为 Luminas 的 IsCollectable 标志不知为何对它返回 true？？？

entries.Original: Increased timeout on turning in collectables, which should enable full inventory turn-ins now
entries.Translated: 增加了提交收藏品的超时时间，现在应该可以完整提交整个背包了

entries.Original: Fixed bought items not adding up anymore
entries.Translated: 修复了已购买物品数量不再累加的问题

entries.Original: Added Lifestream integration and with that new CollectableShop locations Solution Nine and Gridania
entries.Translated: 添加了 Lifestream 集成，并新增了收藏品商店位置：九号解决方案和格里达尼亚
添加了新的票据商店物品：雷光灵砂！
修复了收藏品商店自动化失效的问题。抱歉！
重构了整个自动化处理逻辑

entries.Original: Added /collector stop command to stop automation as well as a window with a stop button that appears when automation is running
entries.Translated: 新增 /collector stop 命令用于停止自动化，以及自动化运行时显示的带停止按钮的窗口

entries.Original: Added new config option to start collecting once you finish fishing
entries.Translated: 新增配置选项：钓鱼结束后自动开始采集

entries.Original: Exposed a few functions via EzIPC
entries.Translated: 通过 EzIPC 暴露了若干函数

entries.Original: Marked Solution nine teleport as not functional & made it not interactable and also set the Eulmore one as default
entries.Translated: 将九号解决方案传送标记为不可用并设为不可交互，同时将游末邦设为默认

entries.Original: Fixed a bug where it would fail to buy items if the quantity was set too high
entries.Translated: 修复了数量设置过高时购买物品失败的 bug

entries.Original: Made certain config settings not interactable if the required plugins are not installed
entries.Translated: 当所需插件未安装时，部分配置项将不可交互

entries.Original: New since you last opened the changelog
entries.Translated: 自上次打开更新日志以来的新内容

entries.Original: Scrip turn-ins, purchases, and gathering loops
entries.Translated: 票据交纳、购买与采集循环

entries.Original: Experimental — hold Shift and click to enable.
entries.Translated: 实验性 — 按住 Shift 并点击以启用。

entries.Original: Add items to your purchase list on the Main tab to see the plan.
entries.Translated: 在主标签页将物品添加到购买列表以查看计划。

entries.Original: vnavmesh plugin is not installed or not ready.
entries.Translated: vnavmesh 插件未安装或未就绪。

entries.Original: Lifestream plugin is required to reach this territory.
entries.Translated: 需要 Lifestream 插件才能前往该区域。

entries.Original: Play Kupo of Fortune to spend held cards
entries.Translated: 玩库啵好运道以消耗持有的卡片

entries.Original:
After a Firmament turn-in, walk to Lizbeth and play any Kupo of Fortune
cards you hold so vouchers earned past the 10-card cap aren't wasted.
entries.Translated:
在天穹街交纳后，走到莉兹贝丝处并玩掉你持有的所有库啵好运道
卡片，以免超过 10 张上限后获得的兑换券被浪费。
持有卡片达到以下数量时游玩：

entries.Original:
Left can only win 2nd-4th prize (avoids the jackpot and the
consolation). Random right can win any of the 5 prizes.
entries.Translated:
左侧只能赢得第 2-4 等奖（避开部队特效：金碟币提高和
慰藉）。随机右侧可赢得全部 5 个奖项。

entries.Original: Buy items after each trade instead of on capping scrips
entries.Translated: 每次交易后购买物品，而非在票据达到上限时购买

entries.Original: Reset each quantity after completing the list
entries.Translated: 完成列表后重置每个数量
钓鱼完成后进行收藏品采集

entries.Original: Auto turn in when opening a collectables window manually
entries.Translated: 手动打开收藏品窗口时自动交纳

entries.Original:
When you open the Collectables shop or the Firmament appraiser (HWDSupply) yourself,
turn in eligible collectables automatically. Skips travel and does not start buying.
entries.Translated:
当你自行打开收藏品商店或天穹街鉴定人（HWDSupply）时，
自动交纳符合条件的收藏品。跳过移动且不会开始购买。

entries.Original: Purchases will leave at least this many scrips of each currency unspent.
entries.Translated: 购买后每种货币至少保留此数量的票据不花费。

entries.Original:
Copies plugin state, settings and dependency status to the clipboard.
Paste it along with your issue report.
entries.Translated:
将插件状态、设置和依赖状态复制到剪贴板。
请随问题报告一并粘贴。
采集完成后启用自动采集

entries.Original: GatherbuddyReborn is not installed or not ready.
Turn in collectables on autogather finish
entries.Translated: 自动采集完成后提交收藏品

entries.Original: Disabled while "Craft selected Artisan list on autogather finish" is enabled (Artisan section).
entries.Translated: 当“自动采集完成后制作所选 Artisan 列表”启用时禁用（Artisan 部分）。

entries.Original: Disabled while "Run resource inspection on autogather finish" is enabled.

entries.Translated: 资源检查完成后制作选定的 Artisan 列表

entries.Original:
After a resource-inspection run finishes (gather → inspect → craft),
start the selected Artisan list.
entries.Translated:
资源检查流程（采集 → 检查 → 制作）结束后，
启动选定的 Artisan 列表。

entries.Original: Craft selected Artisan list on autogather finish
entries.Translated: 自动采集完成后制作选定的 Artisan 列表

entries.Translated: 启用“自动采集完成后交纳收藏品”时禁用（GatherBuddyReborn 部分）。

entries.Original: After GatherBuddyReborn autogather finishes, start the selected Artisan list.
entries.Translated: GatherBuddyReborn 自动采集完成后，启动选定的 Artisan 列表。

entries.Original: Collect on finish crafting an Artisan list
entries.Translated: 完成 Artisan 列表制作后采集收藏品

entries.Original: Pause Artisan when inventory is full, turn in, then resume
entries.Translated: 背包满时暂停 Artisan，交纳后继续

entries.Original:
When the running Artisan list drops below the free-slot threshold and
you have collectables, pause the list, run the turn-in cascade, then
resume the list from where it left off.
entries.Translated:
当运行中的 Artisan 列表低于空闲槽位阈值且
你有收藏品时，暂停列表，执行交纳流程，然后
从暂停处继续列表。

entries.Original: Check for available ventures between runs
entries.Translated: 在运行间隔检查可用探险

entries.Original: AutoRetainer is not installed or not ready.
Run Deliveroo GC turn-ins between runs
entries.Translated: 在运行间隔执行 Deliveroo 大国防联军交纳

entries.Original: Deliveroo is not installed or not ready.
Lifestream plugin is required for Maelstrom GC turn-ins.
entries.Translated: 黑涡斗技场大国防联军交纳需要 Lifestream 插件。

entries.Original: Run any chat command at a point in the loop — e.g. "/li gc" before crafting to craft at your Grand Company "Wait" holds the loop until Lifestream is idle and you can act again before continuing.
entries.Translated: 在循环中的某个节点运行任意聊天命令 — 例如制作前运行“/li gc”以在大国防联军处制作。“等待”会保持循环直到 Lifestream 空闲且你可以再次行动后再继续。

entries.Original: Sent through the chat handler, so plugin commands (/li, /vnav, …) and game commands both work.
entries.Translated: 通过聊天处理器发送，因此插件命令（/li、/vnav、…）和游戏命令均可使用。

entries.Original:
Hold the loop until Lifestream is idle, no zone change is in flight
and you can act again, before the next step runs.
entries.Translated: 在下一步执行前保持循环，直到 Lifestream 空闲、没有正在进行的区域切换且你可以再次行动。

entries.Original: Posts a test message to verify the webhook works.
entries.Translated: 发送测试消息以验证 Webhook 是否可用。

When enabled, automation will stop instead of
re-enabling autogather once all items are purchased.
entries.Translated:
启用后，所有物品购买完毕时将停止自动化，
而不是重新启用自动采集。

entries.Original: Evaluated between turn-in and buy cycles. Counters reset when the plugin reloads.
entries.Translated: 在交纳与购买循环之间评估。插件重载时计数器重置。

entries.Original:
Total scrips estimated earned this session (using HighReward).
Applies across currencies.
entries.Translated:
本次会话预计获得的总票据（使用 HighReward）。
适用于所有货币。

entries.Original: Number of times the shop has been visited and purchases completed.
entries.Translated: 商店访问并完成购买的次数。

entries.Original: Real elapsed minutes since the current session started.
entries.Translated: 当前会话开始以来实际经过的分钟数。

entries.Original:
One full loop = a complete gather → inspect → craft cycle, counted when
autogather is re-enabled. Stops after finishing the current cycle.
entries.Translated:
一个完整循环 = 一次完整的采集 → 检查 → 制作周期，在
重新启用自动采集时计数。完成当前循环后停止。

entries.Original: Hide collectables above your job level
entries.Translated: 隐藏高于当前职业等级的收藏品

entries.Original:
Filters the planner to only show collectables you can
actually gather or craft. Also gates the 'best' pick.
entries.Translated:
筛选规划器，仅显示你实际能够
采集或制作的收藏品。同时限制“最佳”选择。

entries.Original: Starts the pipeline directly, bypassing the automation cascade.
entries.Translated: 直接启动流水线，绕过自动化倾泻。

entries.Original:
Walk to Lizbeth in the Firmament and play any held Kupo of Fortune
cards. Runs standalone — won't trigger the buy/cascade flow.
entries.Translated:
前往天穹街的莉兹贝丝处并游玩所有持有的库啵好运道
卡牌。独立运行——不会触发购买/倾泻流程。

entries.Original: Hold Ctrl to enable destructive buttons.
entries.Translated: 按住 Ctrl 启用危险按钮。
已按住 Ctrl——按钮已激活。

entries.Original: No characters sampled yet — log in or press "Sample current".
entries.Translated: 尚未采样任何角色 — 请登录或点击“采样当前角色”。
各角色最近已知的票据余额。

entries.Original:
Read the active character's scrip balances now.
Balances also refresh automatically after each turn-in and buy cycle.
entries.Translated:
立即读取当前角色的票据余额。
每次交纳与购买循环后余额也会自动刷新。

entries.Original: Unique items can only be owned one at a time
